content: MCP servers expose Tools (typed actions), Resources (structured read access to data/files), and Prompts. Common architecture patterns: Filesystem-style servers with configurable access controls for safe file read/write; SaaS wrapper servers exposing typed action tools; tool-catalog/adapter-hub servers proxying multiple APIs. Reference filesystem server in modelcontextprotocol/servers demonstrates scoping writes to an allowed directory and returning structured results rather than raw bytes.
